text: On April 21, 2021, the City received an Official Plan Amendment and Zoning By-law Amendment application for 9-39 Queens Quay, the Pier 27 development lands. Included in these lands are 19-37 Queens Quay East. 9-39 Queens Quay was developed in phases, the last phase being the Site. An application for an Official Plan Amendment and a Zoning By-law Amendment for the Site were submitted to permit the construction of two buildings; one being 45 storeys (Building F) for residential use and one (Building A) being a mixed-use residential and at-grade retail of 11 storeys. The applicant appealed City Council's refusal of the applications for the Official Plan Amendment and Zoning By-law Amendment, to the Ontario Land Tribunal on October 27, 2025. The City Solicitor requires further directions as an Ontario Land Tribunal hearing is scheduled for March 8, 2027.

City Council on July 29 and 30, 2026, referred Item CC43.26 to the City Solicitor to attempt further negotiations with the owner, including affordable housing opportunities, in consultation with the Executive Director, Development Review and the Chief Planner and Executive Director, City Planning, and report to City Council at the earliest possible opportunity.
